programme.title: E2 - Gardens in the Clouds
programme.desc: The plants and animals of the Cloud Mountains have long captured our imagination. In a landscape defined by weather and threatened by invaders, see how indigenous forests survive by providing a sanctuary for life while opening a door to the past.

programme.title: E1 - Snares Islands/ Tini Heke
programme.desc: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

programme.title: E3 - Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand’s South Island, where one of the world’s longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

programme.title: E4 - The Hauraki Gulf/ Te Moananui a Toi
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures. Catch a glimpse of a stealthy manta ray, enjoy dolphin antics, and admire a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.

programme.title: E6 - Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani
programme.desc: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands’ massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

programme.title: E4 - Platypus Predicament
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow III
programme.desc: The year is 1974. A young Hong Kong Chinese, Mark, travels to Saigon to make his fortune. There, he encounters a mysterious femme fatale, the lovely Kit. As he becomes more involved in her various underworld deals, a tragic romance develops. On the eve of the outbreak of war, Kit's past returns to endanger her, and Mark must risk everything for the one true love of his life...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Fully Funny - Eric Kot
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.title: Bury Me High
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots...

programme.title: Killer's Romance
programme.desc: After learning that his father was killed by the notorious Chinatown Triad, Nidaine becomes a cold-blooded killer determined to get his revenge. When one of his assassinations is witnessed by Jenny, Nidaine plans on silencing her forever. Instead, Nidaine finds himself falling for her, and they must now run for their lives from both the cops and the Triad assassins!

programme.title: E40
programme.desc: Kazumasa defects to the Toyotomi side, throwing the Tokugawa clan into turmoil. Though the Tokugawa seem in no position to fight the Toyotomi, Ieyasu shows no sign of giving up. Just as Hideyoshi decides to mobilize his forces, a massive earthquake strikes, devastating both Osaka and Hamamatsu. The two sides begin exploring a path to peace, but Ieyasu demands one of Hideyoshi's relatives as his wife. The only woman in the Toyotomi family who can marry into the Tokugawa clan is Asahi (Kurasawa Anna).

programme.title: Someone, Someday[Live]
programme.desc: Someone, Someday follows Billy (Kathryn Bernardo), the young CEO of a dating app that empowers women to find their destined true love-while secretly carrying the heartbreak that has kept her from finding her own. Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.

programme.title: The Loyalty Game[Live]
programme.desc: A wife puts her husband to a simple loyalty test, unaware she will unleash a dangerous game of seduction, secrets, and deadly deception. After a troubled night leaves Ana waking up without her husband Ben by her side, she hires Beth to test his loyalty by seducing him. The connivance between wife and loyalty tester soon turns into a dangerous, seductive psychological game of secrets, manipulation, and power play, where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: La Vida Lena
programme.desc: La Vida Lena is a revenge drama about Magda, a talented young woman who is bullied because of a facial scar. After creating a successful beauty soap formula, she becomes the target of the powerful Narciso family. Betrayed and stripped of everything she loves, she returns with a new identity and appearance, determined to exact revenge on those who destroyed her life.

Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.

programme.title: The Loyalty Game[Live]
programme.desc: A wife puts her husband to a simple loyalty test, unaware she will unleash a dangerous game of seduction, secrets, and deadly deception. After a troubled night leaves Ana waking up without her husband Ben by her side, she hires Beth to test his loyalty by seducing him. The connivance between wife and loyalty tester soon turns into a dangerous, seductive psychological game of secrets, manipulation, and power play, where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: La Vida Lena
programme.desc: La Vida Lena is a revenge drama about Magda, a talented young woman who is bullied because of a facial scar. After creating a successful beauty soap formula, she becomes the target of the powerful Narciso family. Betrayed and stripped of everything she loves, she returns with a new identity and appearance, determined to exact revenge on those who destroyed her life.

programme.title: E32
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.desc: 俞笑擁有一段令人外人羨慕的婚姻，然而因一起女高中生的遇害案，警察宋誠發現俞笑成了其與手頭一樁塵封舊案的共同證人，調查過程中，警方發現俞笑丈夫朱鶴好好男人的外表下，藏著無數與案件相關的線索。而對於俞笑而言，遇見宋誠和身份成謎的安妮後，她開始直面多年前的陰影……

Reborn
programme.desc: Ming & Cheng have a son named Won. One day, Won suddenly had a persistent high fever. As a result, Won died due to lack of rescue. She was very sad and thought that Won was still alive. Then, they meet a person name Xia, who could help people heal the pain of losing their loved ones, Xia gave Cheng a doll, which seemed to be just an ordinary doll, but when it reached her hands, the doll turned into Won. But in Ming eyes, he was just a doll. Xia reminds Ming that this doll must not be damaged. Since then, they have lived happily ever after. But Ming began to feel that Cheng was too obsessed with this illusion and felt that the doll was getting spooky and became an unknown object. He could not stand it and secretly destroyed the doll, but what he didn't expect that Cheng still regarded the broken doll as Won. She thought that he killed her son. Ming started arguing with her, hoping to wake her up, but accidentally injured Cheng, then unexpectedly something happened to Ming...
